message: No detected input validation: There are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on incoming data anywhere in the visible code; datasets are loaded and used directly without validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded via torchvision dataset classes (e.g., CIFAR10, MNIST) without any checksum verification, pinned revisions, or source authentication.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label values, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is present anywhere in the data preparation code path.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads models via `architecture.load_from_checkpoint(checkpoint_path)` without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify the integrity of the loaded weights.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection present in the training pipeline.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: The evaluation only runs membership inference, model extraction, knockoff nets, and model inversion attacks; no adversarial robustness tests (FGSM, PGD, Foolbox, ART robustness evaluations) are present in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no hashing or signing of evaluation data, and while train/test datasets are separated, no explicit isolation enforcement, checksums, or multiple independent metric sources are implemented to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: No input shape, range, or schema validation is performed before passing data to the model; inputs are used directly from datasets without sanitization.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs are used directly without NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or bounds validation before being returned or logged.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The models used are image classifiers (CIFAR-10, MNIST, etc.), not LLMs, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
